meta.name: Predict employee attrition risk with Google Sheets, OpenAI, Gmail, and Telegram

name: AI-Powered Employee Attrition Prediction & Retention Analytics

parameters.content:
## ⚠️ Error Handling
A workflow-level error trigger catches any node failure and posts an alert to Slack. Replace `YOUR_SLACK_CHANNEL_ID` with your ops or alerts channel before going live.

## 📊 AI Employee Attrition Prediction & Retention Analytics

### How it works
Every week, the workflow pulls five data sources from Google Sheets — employee master data, attendance records, engagement survey scores, performance reviews, and 1:1 meeting notes — and merges them into a single profile per employee. A rule-based engine computes early risk signals (absenteeism, low engagement, no recent 1:1, declining reviews). Each profile is then sent to an OpenAI model which returns a structured flight-risk assessment with a severity rating and recommended HR action. The composite score (rules + LLM) is evaluated against a threshold: high-risk employees trigger a Telegram alert to HR and get flagged in the Risk Dashboard sheet. Standard cases are logged and all outcomes merge into one audit row. A separate daily branch reads the day's results and emails an HTML digest to the HR team.

### Setup steps
1. Connect **Google Sheets OAuth2** and replace `YOUR_GOOGLE_SHEET_ID` in every Sheets node. Create tabs: `Employees_Master`, `Attendance`, `Engagement_Survey`, `Performance_Reviews`, `OneOnOne_Notes`, `Risk_Dashboard`.
2. Connect **OpenAI API** to the LLM analysis node.
3. Connect **Gmail OAuth2** and update the recipient email in the Send Weekly HR Digest Email node.
4. Connect **Telegram Bot API** and replace `YOUR_TELEGRAM_CHAT_ID` in both Telegram nodes.
5. Adjust the high-risk threshold (default: 70) in the Check High Risk Threshold node.
6. Activate the weekly schedule trigger.

## ⏰ Weekly Trigger & Multi-Source Data Fetch
Fires every week. Reads five Google Sheets in parallel — master employee list, attendance, engagement surveys, performance reviews, and 1:1 notes — before merging them into one unified employee profile per person.

## 🔢 Rule-Based Risk Engine
Merges all five data sources per employee, then calculates early warning signals in code: high absenteeism rate, low engagement score, no 1:1 in the last 30 days, and a declining performance trend. Each rule contributes to a baseline risk score.

## 🤖 LLM Flight Risk Analysis
Builds a structured prompt per employee and sends it to GPT-4o-mini. The model returns a severity rating (Low/Medium/High/Critical), a primary risk factor, and a recommended HR action. If the LLM call fails, the workflow falls back to the rule-based score only and notifies the admin on Telegram.

## 📈 Score Merging & High-Risk Escalation
Combines rule-based and LLM signals into a composite score (0–100). Scores above the threshold (default 70) trigger a Telegram alert to HR and flag the record in the Risk Dashboard sheet. All outcomes — escalated and standard — are merged into a single audit row.

## 📧 Weekly HR Digest
Runs on the same weekly schedule. Reads all risk results logged that day, builds an HTML summary report with employee names, risk levels, and recommended actions, then emails it to the HR team.

## 🔑 Credentials Required
- **Google Sheets OAuth2** — all 7 Sheets nodes
- **OpenAI API** — LLM risk analysis
- **Gmail OAuth2** — weekly HR digest email
- **Telegram Bot API** — high-risk alert + LLM failure admin alert

Never hardcode sheet IDs, emails, or chat IDs in shared templates.
